subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: When the idea or a ruling falls outside the product vision's scope, the skill shall surface the gap explicitly, record the operator's ruling on it, and leave every governing document unmodified.
rationale: governing docs are human-authored inputs; the factory never extends them from below (AP-24)
fit_criterion: on a fixture seeded with an out-of-vision idea, the gap is surfaced and named; across all sessions, zero writes to governed documents (also §3.3, FR-15)
